text:
maria_cs: FYI — overnight we saw a spike of 503 errors on the onboarding ingestion endpoint that impacted a subset of new customers. Need a short customer-facing status, timeline, office hours, and a credit offer. Who can draft?

devops_bot: Alert: 503 spike detected 2026-03-22T04:12Z -> 04:40Z. Peak error rate ~18% on /v1/ingest. Autoscaler fallback event observed at 04:18Z.

jordan_se: I can draft the outbound. Ill keep it concise: 3 short paragraphs, timeline bullets, and an explicit "no data was lost" line.

lee_support: Affected tenants list uploaded to private doc: risky_accounts.csv. High-touch accounts: Acme, BloomOps, NimbusAI, LatticePulse.

jordan_se: Draft below 1 please quick-edit and sign-off for send: 

```
Hi <customer>,

We experienced transient ingestion errors on March 22 that affected a portion of onboarding imports. Root cause: an autoscaler edge-case that briefly routed some import traffic to a trimmed GPU pool during a burst, leading to intermittent 503 responses. Mitigation: we reverted the autoscaler policy and applied a targeted capacity bump at 04:25Z; metrics returned to baseline by 04:40Z.

Timeline (UTC):
- 04:12Z: error spike detected
- 04:18Z: autoscaler fallback observed
- 04:25Z: targeted capacity bump applied
- 04:40Z: error rates normalized

No customer data was lost. We will proactively re-ingest any failed imports for affected tenants and share a detailed RCA within 48 hours.

If youd like live assistance, join office hours on March 23 at 14:00 PT  RSVP: https://go.redwood/office-hours

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

sam_ce: Add a short sentence about the credit offer and how customers claim it.

lisa_legal: Legal check: credit wording OK if you add: 'credits issued within 7 business days after acceptance; non-transferable.' Also confirm SLA band; looks like SLA Level 2 incident.

maria_cs: Action items: Jordan finalize and send to high-touch by EOD; Lee confirm contact emails for the list; Sam run office hours (hosts: sam_ce + ryan_infra + eng-oncall); Lisa provide legal sign-off by 15:00. Ill prepare an exec note for flagged renewals.

lee_support: Tenant-specific notes and emails uploaded in the private doc. Added renewal-risk flags for Acme and NimbusAI.

jordan_se: Sent to high-touch recipients at 09:02. Ill follow up with a broader self-serve notification later today and include a 3-question feedback survey link and a re-ingest status checklist per tenant.

sam_ce: Office hours hosts confirmed: sam_ce, ryan_infra, eng-oncall. Calendar invite + RSVP tracker created and shared in #private-cs-docs.

devops_bot: Fix deployed 2026-03-22T05:02Z. Monitoring currently nominal.

maria_cs: Using this thread as canonical ops record. If anyone receives renewal-risk responses, tag me and Ill escalate. Well capture CSAT pulse in the follow-up and track responses in the shared tracker.

jordan_se: Final RCA draft to be posted here within 36 hours.
